rounds.text: Krishna Filament Industries Ltd presents a valuation profile that is fundamentally disconnected from its underlying financial reality. The stock trades at a P/E ratio of 99.3x [E1], which balloons to 101.6x when compared against a sector benchmark of 23.64x [E6]. This extreme premium is further highlighted by an EV/EBITDA ratio of 173.42x, dwarfing the sector benchmark of 14.17x [E11]. A discounted cash flow analysis suggests an intrinsic value of only Rs 1 per share, resulting in a staggering margin of safety of -298.0% [E29, E30]. Furthermore, the current market price implies an aggressive earnings growth rate of 28.7%, which significantly exceeds the 10.0% growth assumed in the base case [E31]. Conceded: the company maintains a positive ROA of 5.63% against a sector benchmark of 4.68% [E8], and the price-to-book ratio is currently 0x compared to the sector benchmark of 2.58x [E7]. Investors should note that the company provides no dividend yield to compensate for these valuation risks [E4].
